root_cause.text: The error path in `sev_tsm_init_locked()` calls `kfree(t)` before accessing fields of the freed structure `t` in a `pr_err()` statement, causing a use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves the `pr_err()` call before `kfree(t)` in the `error_exit` label. The original code had `kfree(t);` followed by `pr_err(... t->tio_en, t->tio_init_done ...)`, which accesses freed memory.
